日: A bright sun inside a square outline with one central horizontal stroke; an early sun pictograph squared by writing.
人: A person with two long diagonal legs spreading from a small upper body.
本: A tree with a distinct short horizontal mark at its roots, pointing to the base or origin.
見: A large eye above two walking legs, stacked vertically to show seeing.
男: A four-plot field above a strong working figure or arm, matching 田 over 力.
木: One vertical trunk, a horizontal branch, and two diagonal roots: the old tree pictograph.
九: Nine stones arranged three by three next to a large curling nine-shaped stroke.
休: A person leaning against a tree to rest, with the person on the left and tree on the right.
一: One clean long horizontal line, with one apple perched above it.
年: A farmer carrying a sheaf of grain; arrange the grain and crossbars over a long central standing figure to evoke 年. One harvest marks a year.
大: A single person standing with arms spread horizontally and legs spread diagonally, the classic big person pictograph.
十: A clear centered cross made of two broad strokes; ten little fingers on two hands can decorate its ends.
二: Exactly two horizontal bars, upper short and lower long, each carrying one apple.
中: A square box pierced vertically by one strong central pole, creating a line through its middle.
出: Two mountain-like forms stacked, a foot emerging upward from the lower one; the scene reads coming out.
三: Exactly three separated horizontal shelves or bars, one above another.
月: A crescent moon elongated vertically, with two slim horizontal bands within its open body.
生: A green seedling thrusts vertically up through a long ground line, with branching leaves above.
五: Two horizontal bars frame a central bent crossing form; use five small sparkles as a count cue without losing the bars.
上: One long horizontal ground line and a short vertical stroke rising above it, capped by a small horizontal upper mark.
四: A nose inside an enclosure exhales exactly four puffs. The old graph showed a nose exhaling and was later borrowed for four.
金: A roof-like top above earth and gold nuggets beneath; stack them compactly with a central vertical axis.
入: Two tapering diagonal strokes meet high and spread apart below, like an open entrance one walks into.
学: A small child clearly at the bottom under a school roof, with three small light marks over the roof.
円: A coin within a rounded rectangular frame, with one vertical and one central horizontal divider.
八: Two strokes separating diagonally outward from a close top center; eight little stars divided into two groups of four.
六: A small roof at top and two widely separated legs below; six small celebratory stars can surround it.
下: One long horizontal line and a short vertical stroke hanging below it, with a small lower side mark.
気: Curling vapor bands at top with a crossed rice-grain motif lower down; airy invisible energy.
小: One long centered downstroke with exactly two small specks to its left and right.
七: A horizontal stroke crossed by a bent vertical hook near its center; seven small dots may decorate.
山: Three mountain peaks with the center highest, joined by one continuous base.
女: A kneeling woman with her arms crossed or folded over her lap, shaping the three main diagonals.
百: One small top horizontal bar over a sun-like square compartment with an inner horizontal line; the number one hundred.
先: A forward stepping foot or track on top and a walking person's two legs below.
名: Evening crescent above an open mouth calling a name; stacked moon over mouth.
川: Three separate flowing vertical streams, center narrower, from top to bottom.
千: A tiny slanted top mark on a central vertical through a broad horizontal bar, for thousand.
水: A central vertical stream with two distinct side splashes to left and right, matching the four arms of water.
校: A tree on the left and a small crossed-wood school structure on the right; keep strong left/right separation.
土: A stem rises from earth, intersecting one short high bar and one long ground bar below.
車: A cart seen from above: long central axle, horizontal crossbars, and a rectangular wheel frame.
白: A bright white sun inside a square with a top ray, with clear horizontal middle divider.
天: A wide top sky bar above a large person standing with arms out and legs spread.
火: A central leaping flame with two smaller side sparks, spreading like the four strokes of fire.
右: A reaching hand in the upper left reaches toward a mouth in lower right.
左: A reaching hand in upper left works at a little craft bench or ruler in lower right.
雨: A broad roof-like cloud frame with four separate raindrops dangling inside, two per side.
国: A strong square border surrounding one small bright jewel; national enclosure.
長: An elder with strikingly long hair flowing vertically and diagonally down the picture.
時: A bright sun occupying the left half and a compact temple with clock or bell on the right half.
行: A four-way crossing seen from above, its two opposing road branches echoing left and right halves.
後: A path or footsteps on the left, with a lagging person farther back on the right.
前: A boat bow pointing forward above a boat hull, with a small figure at the very front.
間: Two tall gate doors as outer left/right halves with bright sun glowing in the central gap.
東: A rising sun placed within the branches of an upright tree, top and bottom branches visible.
今: A roof-like lid settling over a single present-moment clock face.
高: A tall tiered tower with broad roof, midlevel window, and ground-level gate.
外: An evening crescent at left and a small upright lookout/sign at right, outside a doorway.
来: A central stalk of wheat with outward leaves and grain ears, with a small approaching footstep cue.
話: A speech bubble on the left and a tongue emerging from a mouth on the right.
北: Two people standing back to back, each facing opposite directions.
午: A tall vertical pestle-like stem crossing a horizontal handle, with a small sun high overhead as noon cue.
書: A hand grips a brush at top; its tip marks a rectangular page below.
半: One object symmetrically split down its center by a blade, with a strong central vertical line.
西: A bird tucked into a nest at dusk, contained within a rounded enclosure.
電: A rain cloud with four drops at top, lightning branching downward beneath it.
語: A speech bubble or lines on left; on right a stack of horizontal marks above a mouth, respecting 言 + 吾 layout.
聞: Two tall gate doors enclosing a single large ear at the center.
食: A peaked lid over a bowl full of rice, stacked vertically.
何: A person at left carrying a strange box or load at right, asking what it is.
南: A hanging bell-like object beneath a crossbar, with warm sun motif as south memory cue.
万: A top horizontal stroke over a bent descending hook, with many tiny dots as ten-thousand cue.
毎: An upper headpiece or crown above a mother-like figure with two small internal dots, for every.
母: A rounded seated mother form with two small dots inside, holding a baby, but preserve the two dots.
読: Speech lines on the left and a book stall on the right, for reading; keep the two-part layout.
友: Two outstretched hands clasp, one reaching from above and one from below, to form friendship.
父: A large hand grips one primitive stone axe; the ancient form depicts a hand holding a stone blade.
子: A baby with two arms stretched wide and a rounded lower swaddled body, matching the horizontal arms and central downward hook of 子.
